styles.name: mandelbrot-escape
styles.description: The Mandelbrot set's cardioid-and-bulb silhouette at the bar's centre, with its escape-time equipotential lines spreading outward to fill the bar as progress rises and rippling with time.

styles.name: julia-set
styles.description: Three filled Julia sets side by side — the basilica (c=−1), Douady's rabbit and the spiralling Siegel disk — each sharpening from a round blob into its true shape as progress raises its iteration depth; c trembles gently with time.

styles.name: sierpinski-triangle
styles.description: A row of Sierpinski triangles built from Pascal's triangle mod 2: each starts as a solid triangle and subdivides level by level, left to right, as progress rises; a chaos-game walker hops between vertices with time.

styles.name: koch-curve
styles.description: Koch curve laid along the bar: each middle third grows a triangular bump, again and again — progress rewrites the line left to right at each finer level (straight line → one bump → 4 → 16 → 64), and a spark runs along the finished curve with time

styles.name: barnsley-fern
styles.description: Barnsley's four-map IFS fern laid along the bar: the frond unfurls from its stem toward the tip as progress rises, with alternating leaflets, and sways with time.

styles.name: dragon-curve
styles.description: Heighway dragon by paper folding: four panels show the strip folded 2, 4, 6 and 8 times, each drawing itself in turn as progress rises; a walker retraces finished dragons with time.

styles.name: sierpinski-carpet
styles.description: A row of square Sierpinski carpets: each starts solid, has its centre ninth punched out, then the centre of every remaining ninth, filling in turn as progress rises while a glint sweeps across them with time.

styles.name: burning-ship
styles.description: Burning Ship fractal (z → (|Re z|+i|Im z|)² + c), zoomed onto the little ship near c ≈ −1.76 that gives the set its name: hull on the waterline, masts and rigging rising above — a convoy of them sails in as progress rises, flames flickering with time

styles.name: pythagoras-tree
styles.description: Pythagoras trees: a trunk square carries a right triangle whose two legs carry two smaller squares, and so on — a row of trees each branching level by level as progress reaches it, their crowns swaying gently with time

styles.name: newton-fractal
styles.description: Newton's method on z³−1: each cell is coloured by the cube root it converges to and dotted in convergence-speed bands, so the three basins meet in chains of beads; more of the plane resolves as progress raises the step budget, and the plane turns with time.

styles.name: cantor-dust
styles.description: The Cantor set as its textbook ladder: a full bar, then thirds, ninths, 27ths and 81sts stacked beneath it, each level drawing in as progress rises while a highlight sweeps the surviving dust with time.

styles.name: lyapunov-bar
styles.description: Markus–Lyapunov fractal for the logistic map driven by the sequence AB (a across, b up, both in [3, 4]): stable regions with negative exponent are lit, forming the classic swallow-tail shapes, swept in left to right by progress as the window drifts with time.
